# filename: explore_db.py
import sqlite3
import pandas as pd

# Connect to the database
db_path = './dacomp-080.sqlite'
conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)

# Check the tables
tables_query = "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';"
tables = pd.read_sql_query(tables_query, conn)
print("Tables in database:")
print(tables.to_string(index=False))

# Check the structure of qualtrics__channel_performance
if 'qualtrics__channel_performance' in tables['name'].values:
    table_info = pd.read_sql_query("PRAGMA table_info(qualtrics__channel_performance);", conn)

    print(table_info.to_string(index=False))
    
    # Sample some data

    print("\nSample rows from qualtrics__channel_performance:")
    print(sample.to_string(index=False))
    
    # Check unique distribution_channel values and their total_responses
    channel_totals = pd.read_sql_query("""
        SELECT distribution_channel, SUM(total_responses) as channel_total
        FROM qualtrics__channel_performance
        GROUP BY distribution_channel
        ORDER BY channel_total DESC;
    """, conn)
    print("\nDistribution channels with total_responses (sorted descending):")
    print(channel_totals.to_string(index=False))
    
    # Global total
    global_total = pd.read_sql_query("SELECT SUM(total_responses) as global_total FROM qualtrics__channel_performance;", conn)
    print(f"\nGlobal SUM(total_responses): {global_total['global_total'].iloc[0]}")
else:
    print("Table qualtrics__channel_performance not found!")

conn.close()
